request: Write a polite email body from a bilingual customer to the shop's support team. A desk lamp arrived on Monday with a cracked base. The lamp still turns on, but I have not used it since noticing the crack. I attached a photo of the damage, not a video. I would prefer a replacement rather than a refund. Please confirm whether I should keep the original packaging. If you need the serial number, tell me where to find it. Please reply by Friday because the shop's return window ends that day.

Write a concise handoff message from a lab technician to the bilingual colleague taking the evening shift. At 3 p.m. the centrifuge in room 204 started making a grinding noise, so I stopped it and put a do-not-use sign on it. The six samples that were inside it are now in the blue rack on the second shelf of the fridge. Please run those samples on the backup centrifuge in room 210 before 6 p.m. If the backup centrifuge makes the same noise, stop it and email the facilities manager, not the lab head. A technician is booked to inspect the first centrifuge on Thursday morning. Leave the sign on it until the technician says it is safe to use.

Write a polite notice from the building manager to bilingual tenants. The water will be shut off on Thursday from 9 a.m. to noon so a plumber can replace the main valve in the basement. Fill a few bottles before 9 a.m. if you need water during that time. Do not run the dishwasher or washing machine while the water is off. When the water comes back, it may look cloudy for a few minutes, so let the tap run until it clears. If the water is still cloudy after ten minutes, call the building office. The laundry room will reopen at 1 p.m.

Write a casual group-chat message from a parent to other bilingual parents in a school carpool. I cannot drive on Wednesday this week because of a work trip. Maya's dad offered to take my Wednesday pickup, so please send your kid with their booster seat that morning. Pickup time stays at 3:15 p.m. at the side gate. On Friday the school closes early, so pickup moves to 12:30 p.m. I can take the Friday pickup to make up for Wednesday. Reply here if your kid has an after-school club on Friday.

Write a polite message from a graduate student to their bilingual advisor about a conference poster. I finished the poster draft and uploaded it to the shared drive this morning. The print shop needs the final file by Thursday at noon. Could you look at the results section before Wednesday evening? I shortened the methods section to fit the page, but I kept the sample size and the main figure. If you approve the poster, I will order the print and pick it up on Friday. The department reimburses printing costs if I submit the receipt within a week.

Write a direct message from a restaurant shift lead to the bilingual cook closing tonight. The walk-in fridge door is not sealing well, so close it firmly and check it twice. Move the fish from the top shelf of the walk-in to the small fridge by the grill. Label anything you open tonight with today's date. The dish machine is running hot, so turn it off as soon as the last rack is done. Leave the floor drains uncovered so they dry overnight. If the walk-in reads above 5 degrees at closing, text me a photo of the thermometer.

Write a casual message from someone going away for a week to the bilingual friend who will water their plants. The spare key is under the blue pot by the door. Water the big fern on Monday and Thursday, about one cup each time. The cactus on the windowsill does not need any water this week. If the fern's leaves turn yellow, move it away from the window. Please bring in any packages so they are not left outside. Help yourself to the snacks in the kitchen cupboard.

Write a short message from a software engineer to a bilingual teammate about tonight's release. The release moves from 6 p.m. to 9 p.m. because the database migration failed on the staging server. I rolled back the migration on staging and opened a ticket with the error log. Please do not merge anything into the main branch until the release is out. If the migration passes on staging by 8 p.m., we go ahead at 9 p.m. If it fails again, we postpone the release to tomorrow morning. I will post the final decision in the team channel by 8:15 p.m.

Write a polite message from a dental clinic receptionist to a bilingual patient. The patient's cleaning appointment on Tuesday at 10 a.m. has to move because the hygienist is sick. The clinic can offer Thursday at 2 p.m. or next Monday at 9 a.m. Please reply with the time you prefer by tomorrow evening. If neither time works, call the front desk to find another day. The patient does not need to fill in the health form again. Please bring the new insurance card mentioned at the last visit.

Write a casual group-chat message from a band member to bilingual bandmates. Saturday's rehearsal moves from the usual studio to the drummer's garage because the studio double-booked us. The start time is still 4 p.m. Bring your own amp cables, since the garage has no spares. We will run the three new songs first, then the full set for next week's gig. Street parking is free after 3 p.m. If you cannot make it, tell us by Friday night so we can plan the set without you.

Write a casual group-chat message from a fitness instructor to bilingual class members. Thursday's 7 p.m. spin class moves to studio B because studio A's air conditioning is broken. The class still starts at 7 p.m. sharp. Bring your own water bottle, since the fountain in studio B is out of order. The bikes in studio B have different pedals, so wear regular sneakers instead of clip-in shoes. If you booked a bike online, your spot is saved. Message me by Wednesday night if you need to cancel.

Write a polite text message from a prospective tenant to a bilingual landlord. I would like to see the one-bedroom apartment on Saturday at 11 a.m. if that time is still open. I can bring proof of income and a reference letter from my current landlord. Please let me know whether the parking space is included in the rent. I also want to confirm that small pets are allowed. If Saturday does not work, Sunday afternoon is also fine for me. Please reply by Friday so I can arrange the day off.

Write a casual group-chat message from a neighbor organizing a potluck for bilingual neighbors. The potluck is next Sunday at 5 p.m. in the courtyard. Please add what you are bringing to the shared sign-up sheet so we do not end up with five salads. We already have enough drinks, so bring a main dish or dessert instead. Label anything with nuts because two kids have allergies. If it rains, we will move into the lobby. Bring your own plate and fork to cut down on trash.

Write a polite notice from a public librarian to bilingual library members. The return box outside the main entrance will be closed from Monday to Wednesday for repairs. During that time, return books at the front desk during opening hours. No late fees will be charged for items due on those three days. Laptops and tablets must still be returned in person to staff. The book drop at the north branch is open as usual. Questions can go to the front desk by phone or email.

Write a casual message from someone at work to their bilingual roommate about a package. A delivery is arriving today between 2 and 4 p.m., and it needs a signature. It is a replacement router, so please do not leave it in the hallway. If you are not home, the driver will leave a slip and take it back to the depot. Put the old router by the front door so I can return it tomorrow. Do not unplug the old one until the new one is set up. I will be home around 7 p.m. and will set it up then.

Write a friendly message from a food bank coordinator to bilingual volunteers. This Saturday's shift starts at 8 a.m. instead of 9 a.m. because a large delivery is coming early. Please park behind the building, not in the front lot. Wear closed-toe shoes, since we will be moving heavy boxes. Gloves and aprons will be on the table by the loading door. The shift still ends at noon. If you can only come at 9 a.m., reply here so I can plan the sorting teams.

Write a polite message from a bicycle repair shop to a bilingual customer. The customer's bike is ready for pickup after the brake repair. We also replaced the rear tire because it had a deep cut, as discussed on the phone. The total is the same as the estimate we gave. The shop is open until 6 p.m. on weekdays and until 4 p.m. on Saturday. Please bring the claim ticket when you come. If you cannot pick it up within a week, let us know so we can keep it in storage.

Write a casual group-chat message from a student to bilingual classmates in a study group. Tomorrow's session moves from the library to the student center because the library is closing early. We will meet in room 3B on the second floor at 6 p.m. Bring the practice exam we got on Monday. I will bring the answer key that the teaching assistant posted. We will go through questions 1 to 10 first, then split up the rest. If the room is taken, wait for me at the café downstairs.

Write a polite email from a bilingual traveler to a hotel about an upcoming stay. I have a reservation for three nights starting next Thursday. My flight lands at 8 a.m., so I would like to ask whether early check-in is possible. If the room is not ready, could I leave my luggage at the front desk? I also requested a quiet room away from the elevator when I booked. Please confirm whether breakfast is included in my rate. I will be traveling with a work laptop and need a desk in the room.

Write a casual message from a coworker to bilingual teammates about a team lunch. We are going to the noodle place across the street on Friday at 12:30 p.m. to celebrate the project launch. The manager is paying, so you do not need to bring money. Please reply with your order by Thursday so I can call it in ahead of time. They have vegetarian and gluten-free options. If you have a meeting at that time, we can save you a seat until 1 p.m. We will walk over together from the lobby.

Write a casual message from a dog owner to a bilingual friend who is watching the dog this weekend. Feed him one cup of dry food in the morning and one cup at night. His medicine is in the small blue bottle on the counter, one pill with dinner. Walk him twice a day, but keep him on the leash because he chases cats. He is not allowed on the couch, even if he looks sad. The vet's number is on the fridge in case anything happens. I will be back on Sunday around 6 p.m.

Write a polite message from a project manager to a bilingual client. Tomorrow's 10 a.m. call needs to move because our designer is out sick. Could we meet on Thursday at 10 a.m. or Friday at 2 p.m. instead? The agenda stays the same: the homepage mockups and the launch timeline. I will send the updated mockups by end of day today so you can review them first. If neither time works, please suggest a slot that suits you. The video link from the original invitation will still work.

Write a polite message from a customer to a bilingual bakery owner about a cake order. I would like to order a chocolate cake for twelve people for Saturday afternoon. Please write "Happy 60th, Dad" on top in white icing. One guest is allergic to peanuts, so the cake must not contain any nuts. I can pick it up at 2 p.m. If you need a deposit, I can pay it when I stop by on Thursday. Please let me know the total price before then.

Write a casual group-chat message from a neighbor to bilingual neighbors about a shared garage sale. The sale is this Saturday from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m. on our street. Put a price sticker on each item before you bring it out. Tables go on the sidewalk, but leave the driveways clear for cars. Anything left at 1 p.m. goes to the donation truck that comes at 2 p.m. Bring small bills and coins for change. Reply here if you want me to add your house to the map we are posting.

Write a friendly message from a guitar teacher to a bilingual student. Next week's lesson moves from Tuesday to Wednesday at the same time, 5 p.m. Please practice the two chord changes we worked on, at least ten minutes a day. Bring the songbook, because we will start the second song. Change your strings before the lesson if they still sound dull. If you cannot make Wednesday, tell me by Monday so I can offer the slot to someone else. The lesson fee stays the same.

Write a warm message from a couple to bilingual friends about their wedding RSVP. Please reply to the invitation by the end of this month. Let us know if you will bring a plus-one, so we can plan the seating. Tell us about any food allergies, because the caterer needs a final list. The ceremony starts at 3 p.m., and guests should arrive by 2:30 p.m. There is free parking behind the venue. If you cannot come, we would still love a short message.

Write a short notice from an IT administrator to bilingual staff. The file server will be down for maintenance on Saturday from 10 p.m. to 2 a.m. Save and close any open files before you leave on Friday. Email and the chat app will keep working during the maintenance. Files saved to the server during that window may be lost. After the maintenance, restart your computer before reconnecting. Report any missing files to the help desk on Monday morning.

Write a polite message from a teacher to bilingual parents about a class trip. The class will visit the science museum next Friday. Please sign and return the permission slip by Wednesday. Students need a packed lunch and a water bottle, since there is no cafeteria. The bus leaves school at 9 a.m. and comes back by 2:30 p.m. Students should wear the school T-shirt so we can spot them easily. If you can join as a volunteer, please let me know by Monday.

Write a friendly message from a coworking space manager to a bilingual member. Your fixed desk moves from the window row to desk 14 by the kitchen, starting Monday. We will move your monitor and drawer for you over the weekend. Please take any personal items off the old desk by Friday evening. Your access card will still work at the same doors. The printer code stays the same. If the new spot does not work for you, tell me and I will look for another one.

Write a polite notice from a building manager to bilingual residents about the laundry room. The second dryer is broken, and a repair technician comes next Tuesday. Until then, please limit each dryer load to one hour. Clean the lint filter after every use. Do not leave laundry in the machines overnight. The laundry room still closes at 10 p.m. If a machine eats your coins, write your unit number on the form by the door.

Write a casual text from a hairdresser to a bilingual regular customer. I have to move your Thursday 4 p.m. haircut because I have a family event. I can do Friday at 4 p.m. or Saturday at 11 a.m. instead. If you still want the color touch-up, Saturday works better because it takes longer. Please come with dry hair, as usual. Text me back which time you prefer. Sorry for the change, and thanks for being flexible.

Write a casual message from a friend to a bilingual friend about an airport pickup. My flight lands at 9:40 p.m. on Sunday at terminal 2. I only have a carry-on, so I will come out quickly. Please wait at the pickup area outside door 5 instead of parking. If the flight is late, I will text you when I land. I will pay for gas and the toll. If you cannot make it, no worries, I will take a taxi.

Write a polite message from a recruiter to a bilingual candidate. We would like to invite you to a second interview for the marketing role. It will be on Thursday at 1 p.m. by video call and will last about forty-five minutes. You will meet the team lead and one designer. Please prepare a short case study from a past project. The video link will arrive by email the day before. If Thursday does not work, reply with two other times this week.

Write a friendly group message from a volunteer to bilingual neighbors about a park cleanup. The cleanup is on Sunday from 9 a.m. to noon at the east entrance of the park. Gloves and trash bags will be provided at the sign-in table. Wear long pants because of the bushes near the pond. Do not pick up needles or broken glass; mark them with the orange flags instead. Kids are welcome if an adult stays with them. We will share coffee and snacks at the end.
